presentation.summary: Choose MediUX artwork from AURA in Silo's image picker.
presentation.description_markdown: Provides movie and series posters, backdrops and season posters for manual selection. Requires Silo's image_picker_lookup_provider_ids support.
presentation.setup_markdown: Save your **AURA address** and **API token**, test the connection, and enable **AURA Artwork** in your movie and series library provider priorities. Open **Edit Metadata > Images** on a title to choose artwork. AURA must have configured libraries and a populated library cache. Its address must be reachable from both Silo and the browser displaying previews.

capabilities.description: MediUX artwork for manual selection using TMDB IDs.

global_config_schema.title: AURA connection
global_config_schema.description: Connect to your running AURA API.

fields.label: AURA address
fields.description: AURA IP address and API port, or an HTTPS URL. Use the API port, not the web app port.

fields.label: API token
fields.description: AURA's existing API key, sent as X-Api-Key.
